newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established on a live basis, compared to Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers:Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075 lbs 2 ld 67.50
Carcass Basis (weight only) - compared to Wednesday's close: Slaughter steers and heifers not well established.

Steers: Select and Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs few west 106.00-107.00 Holstein: (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales. Holsteins: ( grade & weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 104.00-105.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 98.00-101.00 Heifers: Select and Choice 2-4 1100 lbs 2 ld west 106.00.
